QUOTE: The library never creates threads: no `pthread_create` or `std::thread` appears under `library/` or `include/`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer states that the library creates no threads. It does not say that library/ supplies the mutex abstraction for threaded callers. It says the mutex layer is compiled out by default and is declared in `include/mbedtls/threading.h`, so the second half of the contrast is missing.
